_comment: T-31 room picker (13-10). Looping room videos that replace the TALK view's painted plate (the default room's B-talk-plate.png) when the owner picks one; the room named by `default` is the start room when its video is installed, else 'current' (no video). Geometry is in the talk plate's own pixel space (plateSize). A video frame (videoSize) is first placed at `identity` (how the stills were made: the 16:9 centre crop y=60..1140 of the plate), then scaled by framing.scale about `pivot` (the talk camera's principal point = its horizon row, so a scale reads as a longer lens / a closer room, never as a tilt), then shifted by framing.offsetX/offsetY (plate px). The result must cover every crop window the talk view can show (scripts/check-room-picker.mjs). The plate's painted chair is drawn back over the video from `chair` (scripts/gen-scene-chair.py). Videos: packaged builds read <resources>/<packagedDir>/<file>; a dev run reads <localDir>/<file> when this manifest names one, else the owner's video folder (src/main/owner-values.json roomsVideoDir), or ZUMI_ROOMS_VIDEO_DIR. A missing or changed file (size/sha256) drops that room from the list.
